cohort: 627 women who underwent bariatric surgery (107 with pregnancy after surgery) and 345 non-bariatric women who delivered at a tertiary perinatal center
finding: Patients who had undergone bariatric surgery had a lower risk of GDM, PIH, preterm delivery, and LGA infants, but a higher risk of cesarean section and SGA infants compared to matched controls.
mod_finding: Patients after bariatric surgery had a higher cesarean section rate compared to the control group (57.38% vs. 40.98%, p = 0.0987).
